bukti: The research aims to classify the bunches into four categories which are unripe, under ripe, ripe and over ripe.
Two images for each category were taken simultaneously from the front and back sides of each fruit bunch.
The masked areas of the front and back side of the images will be calculated.
catatan: Tandan sudah dipanen dan difoto dari sisi depan dan belakang; persentase area matang kedua sisi dirata-ratakan untuk satu label per tandan (50 tandan, 7 salah klasifikasi, akurasi 86% di teks dan 85% di abstrak). Lokasi pemotretan tidak dinyatakan selain 'uncontrolled environment'. Bukan C1 karena tidak ada pencacahan atau penautan buah antarcitra; dua pandang hanya digabung untuk klasifikasi.

bukti: This study investigates the effect of background subtraction on the performance of a deep neural network to accurately identify the ripeness of palm oil fruitlets i.e. ripe, unripe and over ripe.
catatan: Objeknya brondolan atau buah satuan (fruitlet), bukan tandan utuh; abstrak tidak menyebut lokasi pengambilan citra, modalitas (diasumsikan RGB), maupun angka hasil. Bila citra diambil di laboratorium, kode tetap C3 menurut pengecualian sawit.

bukti: A custom dataset of 2000 images was obtained from a palm oil plantation in the Selangor region of Malaysia to train and test models.
The YOLOv5s model proved the most effective for real-time detection of palm oil FFBs, with a 98.5% F1-score and a solid 35.76 Frames per Second (FPS).
catatan: Deteksi tandan dengan kelas kematangan, tanpa pencacahan. Abstrak menyebut citra dari kebun tetapi tidak menyatakan apakah tandan masih di pohon atau sudah di tanah, sehingga lokasi diberi '?'.

bukti: This paper presents the ripeness classification of oil palm fresh fruit bunch (FFB) using artificial neural network (ANN).
A total of 80 oil palm FFB samples from unripe, underripe, ripe and overripe categories were collected. Images of oil palm FFB were obtained using a color digital camera
catatan: Abstrak tidak menyebut lokasi pemotretan (sampel tandan dikumpulkan, kemungkinan sudah dipanen) dan tidak menyebut jumlah citra per tandan.

c1.hasil_ringkas: Deteksi Faster R-CNN (mAP 0,6357 pada IoU 0,5) dengan pelacakan KCF pada video ponsel malam hari, lalu kalibrasi linear terhadap panel yang dihitung manual, menghasilkan galat rerata jumlah tandan anggur 4,9% (maksimum 12,6%) pada dua musim dan dua kultivar; cara tradisional 7,9% (maksimum 23,5%).

bukti: Detected objects were then tracked from frame to frame using a Kernelized Correlation Filter (Henriques et al., 2014 ) to prevent double counting. New detections were associated with previous trackers using an intersection over union metric (IOU).
These counts are then linearly calibrated using a subset of manually counted panels to help account for any occlusion or double counting that may occur in the computer vision pipeline.
each panel was counted a second time during harvest and used as a baseline for measurement.
catatan: Duplikat dihapus oleh pelacakan KCF dengan asosiasi IoU (M3); kalibrasi linear terhadap hitungan manual (M1) mengoreksi sisa oklusi dan hitung ganda. Teks dibaca dari HTML penerbit, bukan PDF, sehingga halaman dikosongkan. Tidak ada metrik identitas.
